entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to process a return for a VeloBand Pulse. Just send me the label.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number?
VF-987654321. I'm aware it's day 11, but your website wasn't working.

Thank you. I see the order here, delivered on December 30th. To make sure I understand the situation fully, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or a matter of preference?
Preference. I tried to return it two days ago, which was within the 10-day window. But your portal had a major website error. I couldn't get anything to load.
I understand your frustration. Let me check on that. Can you confirm the date you attempted the return?
It was the 8th. The entire system was down. I took a screenshot of the error page because I figured this would happen.

Thank you for that information. I can confirm on our end that we had a known system outage on January 8th that affected the returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience. Since our system being down is the reason you couldn't print the label in time, I will absolutely approve this return for you as an exception.
Okay, good. So you're sending the label?

Yes. I've just processed the exception and emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. You'll receive a full refund to your original payment method once our warehouse receives the item. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
